key_decisions.decision: Retains animal’s specific male sex and wholeness, while reading acceptance rather than imposing voluntariness on lirṣono.
Preserves hand contact, acceptance and atonement without adding a theory of transfer or an unmentioned confession.
Distinguishes the offerer’s slaughter from priests’ blood presentation and splashing, matching Exodus’ blood-action terminology.
Clarifies washing versus priestly burning and retains all scope and offering-by-fire/aroma terminology consistent with Exodus; vocabulary notes the alternate food-gift sense.
Retains both flock species and specifically male unblemished animal without importing cattle’s entrance wording.
Keeps priestly killing and draining distinct from mammal blood splashing; names the head as burned before the body is prepared.
Chooses crop/contents with alternate feathers sense noted; retains east side and disposal site.
Preserves tearing without full division, material placement and exact closing refrain; quote closure is an editorial chapter boundary.
